test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

SUFFICIENT
solution: The correct answer is '**Inadequate**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Sufficient**' is '**Inadequate**'. • **Sufficient**: as much as is necessary; enough. (जितना आवश्‍यक हो उतना; पर्याप्त) • *Example: We have **sufficient** oil reserves to last for three months.* • **Inadequate**: not enough; not good enough. (अपर्याप्त, नाकाफ़ी; अयोग्‍य) • *Example: the problem of **inadequate** housing...* **Correct Answer:__** *Inadequate.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Precise**: clear and accurate. (स्‍पष्‍ट और सही) • **Intense**: very great, strong, or serious. (बहुत अधिक, उग्र या गंभीर) • **Enough**: as much or as many of something as necessary. [पर्याप्त, काफ़ी, जितना (मात्रा या संख्‍या) आवश्‍यक हो उतना] 40:T773, The correct answer is '**within**'.
